scripts.dev: bun run dev:server & bun run dev:web
scripts.start: bun run start:server & bun run start:web
scripts.start:web: bun run --cwd apps/web build && bun run --cwd apps/web preview
scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/shared build && bun run --cwd apps/server build && bun run --cwd apps/web build
scripts.test: bun test apps/server && bun run --cwd apps/web test && bun run --cwd packages/shared test
scripts.check: biome check . && bun run typecheck && bun run test
